name: Supermarket Love Quest
source:
This is the last chance you have to not suck at dating. No more getting left swipes, now you can test your luck in the local supermarket and meet people face to face.

Choose carefully...

Cause what's worse than getting embarassed in public with people doing their regular grocerie shopping?

[From [url=https://siccada.itch.io/supermarket-love-quest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是你摆脱“约会废柴”头衔的最后机会了！告别交友软件上没完没了的左滑拒绝，现在就去当地超市碰碰运气，与心仪对象来一场面对面的邂逅吧。

请务必谨慎做出选择……

毕竟还有什么比在日常买菜逛超市的大庭广众之下当场社死更惨的事呢？

[摘自[url=https://siccada.itch.io/supermarket-love-quest]itch.io[/url]]
